why: `nros::pre_shutdown(cb, ctx)` -- the free-function spelling of the PRE-shutdown phase over the global executor, next to `nros::on_shutdown`. rclcpp has a free `rclcpp::on_shutdown` but no free pre-shutdown form; having only the post-teardown one as a free function would leave the half that matters on a device reachable only through the executor object. The phase itself is recorded on `cpp:Executor::add_pre_shutdown_callback` (exec/). Issue 0790.
